For four years he has been happily obsessively combing through sandbanks and river courses. For Ray, the search for gold has little to do with luck and much to do with meticulous research. He is certain that he has found the perfect spot.

programme.title: Gronland - In the Glare of Ice
programme.desc: Greenland is the largest island in the world and the landmass closest to the North Pole. 80% of the country is covered by a layer of ice up to 3000 meters thick. Most of the inhabitants of the country are spread over the breathtaking landscape of the ice-free west coast. The country is mostly inhabited by Inuit, who have been feeding on what nature has provided them for thousands of years. But the original life is in a state of change. The modernisation of society and man-made global warming threaten the Arctic natural paradise that is so incredibly important for our planet. Through the eyes of locals we get to know the authentic Greenland.

programme.title: Masai Mara: The Big Hunt
programme.desc: When food supply in the Serengeti dwindles, the Masai Mara is a paradise for predators. As the black wildebeests, gazelles, zebras and antelopes make their yearly trip from the south of the Serengeti to the north, nature’s best laid trap, the Mara River in Kenya is waiting ahead. Captivating shots filmed under water show how crocodiles prepare for the Big Hunt while other predators lurk on the banks awaiting their bounty. The biggest problems for the migratory animals are the Mara and the Tarek River, where they have to put their lives at risk to get to the other side. A great number of them die as they jump into the river and break their legs, while others are carried away by the drift or drown. Those who are not victims of the river itself risk falling prey to the crocodiles. We entered this unchartered territory, the crocodile domain by heading under water. Follow these predators in and around their habitat and watch prides of lions map out their game plan. In slow-motion, we show you the final showdown between predator and prey. Will it be a successful hunt or will the hoofed animals persevere?

programme.title: Mantises - Masters of Deception
programme.desc: They are killers. They kill with unbelievable precision. They fight Kung Fu style and are seen in Japan as a symbol of vigilance - the mantises. Their triangular head with its unique flexibility is conspicuous. Two overdimensioned eyes fixate the distance to their prey rapidly and three-dimensionally. The chest segment of the mantis is prolonged and equipped with spiny appendages that can spear their prey as fast as a jack knife. The mysterious aura that surrounds the praying mantis has a lot to do with the fact that they are rarely seen. They have adapted to their surroundings perfectly. No matter whether leaves, blossoms, tree bark, sandy floors or even orchids - the mantis adjusts to all environments.

programme.title: The Seychelles - Africa with South Seas ambience
programme.desc: The 115 islands and islets that make up the Seychelles present a breath-taking variety of plants, rare animals and beaches laced with palms. This is where the leg-endary Coco de Mer palm nuts grow with fruits weigh-ing up to 20 kilos and giant wild land turtles nibble away at mangrove fruits to their hearts content. The archipelago was first settled at the end of the 18th cen-tury. Today, a very colourful potpourri of peoples in this dwarf state proves just how peacefully different cultures can live side by side. Three times a week, the steamer "MV Espoir" completes the trip from the main island of Mahé to Praslin and back. A ship for every-one and practically everything: Used cars, toilet paper, horses, bicycles, furniture - you name it, the Espoir transports goods of all kinds. Coconuts sometimes pose a problem as there are far too many of them. What to do with them? The best place to send them is undoubt-edly Hubert Roumien's Virgin Coconut Oil Laboratory, hidden away in the Mahé jungle. Straw turns into gold at Seaweed Seychelles! There, Benjamin Port Louis collects seaweed and extracts liquid fertiliser from it.

programme.title: Over the Islands of Africa
programme.sub-title: Over the Islands of Africa, Zanzibar
programme.desc: Photographer Matthias Ziegler is an Africa specialist. He has visited nearly every country on the continent on assignments for international agencies. Zanzibar, however, is new territory for him. He's come to the former slave island for a photo book – and this time he's not alone. To see the Tanzanian archipelago from the air, he has enlisted the services of ultralight pilot Richard Meredith-Hardy of England to fly him around in his FIB, or flying inflatable boat. Perfect conditions for an adventurous journey: as a world champion ultralight pilot, Richard and his FIB can take off and land practically anywhere – in theory.

Renaud wanted to be a jet pilot, studied music at the Sorbonne, became a ski instructor, model and photographer's assistant before he found happiness in his current vocation. He especially likes to do his job in Mauritius – nowhere else does he find so many motifs as on the "sweetest pearl in the Indian Ocean". This time he's working on a photo book about Mauritius – by land, by water and in the air.

programme.title: Montenegro - From the Black Mountains to the Beach
programme.desc: The Balkan land of Montenegro owes its name to the Black Mountains. But there is so much more: steep cliffs, deep gorges, picturesque lakes, orthodox monasteries, Venetian architecture, sandy beaches and even fjords like those of Norway. There are three climate zones alone in the Adriatic. The inhabitants still try to find their way between the challenges of a post-socialist system, the much-vaunted Balkan remoteness and the opportunities of a still almost completely undiscovered tourist destination in Europe.

programme.title: mareTV: The Blue and White Island World of Greece: Mykonos, Naxos and Tinos
programme.desc: Around the once sacred Isle of Delos, some 200 islands, including 20 larger ones, are arranged almost in a circle. This is where the name of the Greek island paradise comes from: Cyclades, a derivation of the Greek word kýklos, circle. Each cyclade has a unique character. The pelican Petros, about 20 years old, is the mascot of Mykonos. He moves from taverna to taverna all day long, scrounging fish. This works out sometimes well and sometimes not so well. Petros does have a few human friends who regularly slip him something, but all too often visitors eager to take pictures block his path. Then he has to "wiggle" his way through the crowd. Jackie Onassis is said to have once brought Petros' "great-grandmother" from Louisiana to the island.

programme.title: mareTV: Santorini - The Beauty on the Powder Keg
programme.desc: The Santorini archipelago is a gem, but is located on a veritable powder keg. It is only a matter of time before the volcano, the crater rim of which gave us this island world, erupts again. Since January 2011, threatening rumblings have been perceived beneath the archipelago. On Santorini, it's a case of getting nowhere fast without a mule. Whether the restaurant terraces above the abyss of Oia, the hotels on the breath-taking cliffs of Imerovigli or Firostefani, it was only with the help of the stubborn climbing artists, that these daring constructions were made possible. Antonis Vlachos has ten strong mules that work for him. He transports almost everything with them: stones, food or the typically blue paint for the church domes. Santorini is a tourist magnet and up to five cruise ships call in at the islands daily. However, there is no port, just a narrow, concrete quay. Without the tender boats, no guests would ever reach the shore.

programme.title: North Macedonia: Between Traditional Dances and Mini Navy
programme.desc: Northern Macedonia emerged from being a once constituent republic of the former Yugoslavia. Anyone wishing to discover unknown worlds has every chance of finding them in this young Balkan country, full of imposing mountains, lakes of crystal-clear water, original villages and centuries-old customs. Nevertheless, Northern Macedonia, which borders Serbia in the north and Greece in the south, considered to be one of the poorest countries in Europe.

programme.title: The Turkish Riviera - The flair of antiquity and a turquoise sea
programme.desc: With a coastline boasting miles of bathing beaches, turquoise waters, breath-taking cliffs whilst being steeped in history, the Turkish riviera was even a fa-vourite of the Ancient Greeks, Romans and Ottomans, who all loved the mild climate and the lush landscape. Near the ruins of the ancient city of Side, Menderes Akdemir works on the latest attraction aimed at Riviera holidaymakers: his spooky pirate ship "Big Kral" is due to leave dry dock and head for the sea. Mehmet Özata came up with a very clever idea: to be able to cope with the basically ruinous puffer fish plague along the coastline, he produces a selection of leather utensils made of their skin. The islands that surround the sunk-en city of Simena are hugely popular, despite the very modest infrastructure and lack of shopping facilities. This is why Fatma and Ahmet Mazili have transformed their small rowing boat into a floating snack bar. An-other gap in the market was brought to life by Ufuk Secgin. He came up with the idea of providing Halal Holidays, vacations that conform to Islam. For Muslims to be able to relax on holiday, much has to be well organised, with a copy of the Koran and a prayer rug seen as the absolute minimum requirements

programme.title: Penguin City - South Georgia
programme.desc: In the middle of the Antarctic Ocean, an entire mountain range arises from the water: South Georgia, the nursery of the Antarctic. Hundreds of thousands of penguins, elephant seals, fur seals and their young overcrowd the beaches. The rough weather and the extremely difficult access to the island cause filmmaking to be an endeavor requiring much of the film crew around Roland Gockel and Rosie Koch and the state of the art cameras. A lot of patience and sensitivity over a period spanning some five years now offers unknown and poignant insights into the life of the King Penguins on South Georgia Island

programme.title: New Life
programme.desc: It's a water world and life couldn't survive without it. And thanks to it, a mind blowing diversity of creatures thrive beneath the surface. Born to enjoy the riches underwater they must master their body's adaptations, learn to find food, to escape danger and above all become expert swimmers! Whether it's in rivers, on beaches or in the deep ocean, all must overcome the obstacles and fulfil their destiny, all are born to swim! Of all the habitats on earth, the ocean is perhaps the most challenging. Here salt, temperatures, currents and predators can make life difficult; it's not an obvious place to want to bring up your babies… But even in these waters generation after generation beats the odds. They have overcome the challenges and become some of the most beautiful and graceful of creatures. But any baby born to swim has a lot to learn… All over the world there are creatures born to swim, and though humans are not, we seem determined to join them. Perhaps we are envious of their grace. Maybe we are all water babies at heart

Knochenjobs
programme.desc: Mit extrem hohen Temperaturen müssen Metallgießer fertig werden. Ihre Aufgabe ist es, aus flüssigem Metall harte Formen zu machen, sei es für den Maschinenbau oder die Autoindustrie. Sorgfalt und Konzentration sind hier immer das oberste Gebot. Wie sind die Schutzanzüge aufgebaut? Wie ertragen die Augen Hitze und Helligkeit und was fasziniert die Männer so sehr an diesem Beruf?

programme.title: Knochenjobs
programme.desc: Höhenangst dürfen Windkraft-Servicetechniker eher nicht haben. Dies ist der Arbeitsplatz der Techniker von Siemens Gamesa, einem spanischen Windkraft-Erzeuger. Weder bei der Wartung noch der Reparatur dürfen sie schwache Nerven oder Höhenangst haben, denn wo sie arbeiten, hilft ihnen kein Gerüst. Die seilgestützte Höhenarbeit spart den Auftraggebern viel Geld.

programme.title: Knochenjobs
programme.desc: Auch unter Zeitdruck darf man nicht die Konzentration verlieren. Straßenbau-Projektleiter Heiko Schmidt weiß, dass seine Männer unter Zeitdruck stehen, denn die wichtige Hauptstadtverkehrsader soll so schnell wie möglich wieder befahrbar sein. Dennoch muss die Qualität stimmen. Die Männer müssen mit Lärm, Wetter und Staub fertig werden.

programme.title: Berufsgeheimnisse
programme.desc: Es gibt eine neuartige Methode, die bei Hirnmetastasen Hilfe verspricht - ohne Operation und ohne Skalpell: Das so genannte Cyberknife. Ein Roboter gibt präzise und exakt berechnete Strahlen ab. Sie zerstören die Metastasen gezielt, ohne das Hirngewebe zu schädigen.

programme.title: Berufsgeheimnisse
programme.desc: Eine russische Patientin ist extra aus Moskau angereist, um sich von Hirnspezialist Prof. Peter Vajkoczy operieren zu lassen. Sie hat einen bösartigen Hirntumor. Schon an mehreren Kliniken hat sie sich Rat geholt. Professor Vajkoczy wagt sich an den schwierigen Eingriff am Gehirn.

programme.title: Die Kultschrauber
programme.desc: In Tom's Roadhouse bekommt ein Oldie-VW-Bus aus Arizona eine Frischzellenkur, während bei Lundtauto in Berlin ein Porsche 911 aus den 1970er Jahren auf eine Komplettrestaurierung wartet. In der Werkstatt der Minis Hamburg kommen nur die britischen Originale auf die Hebebühne. Allein auf Motorroller und Mopeds mit Charakter haben sich die Flying Classics spezialisiert.

programme.title: Die Kultschrauber
programme.desc: Alte Minis haben eine Schwachstelle: Rost. Die Schrauber der Minis Hamburg lassen heute die Flex kreisen. Porsche-Spezialist Thomas Lundt hat sich der anspruchsvollen Restaurierung von Oldtimern verschrieben, während bei den Flying Classics in Hamburg ein Roller der Kultmarke Vespa aufgebaut wird. Das Team von Tom´s Roadhouse verpasst der top restaurierten Chevelle eine neue Wasserpumpe.

programme.title: Inside New York
programme.desc: Es ist keine leichte Aufgabe, eine riesige Metropole wie New York City am Leuchten zu halten, schließlich besteht sie aus rund einer Million Gebäude. Und da sich auch New York auf eine grünere und nachhaltigere Zukunft zubewegt, muss sich die Art und Weise, auf die der nötige Strom erzeugt wird, weiterentwickeln.

programme.title: Inside New York
programme.desc: Es ist keine leichte Aufgabe, das Wasser aus den Reservoirs im Norden des Bundesstaates zu den Wasserhähnen von über 8,5 Millionen Menschen in New York City zu bringen. Fast 5 Milliarden Liter werden in der Stadt täglich benötigt, doch diese müssen zunächst gereinigt und über Tausende von Kilometern unterirdischer Tunnel transportiert werden.

programme.title: Mensch, St. Pauli! - Geschichten rund um die Reeperbahn
programme.desc: Auf 930 Metern Länge tummeln sich Travestiekünstler, Notärzte im Einsatz, Stripper und jede Menge Krawallmacher, die nicht selten ihren Weg in die berühmt berüchtigte Davidwache finden. Denn die Gewalt nimmt zu auf der „Geilen Meile“, wenn der Alkoholpegel steigt und die Party beginnt. Doch Drag Queen Olivia Jones führt ihre Besucher beherzt und sicher durch den quirligen Kiezdschungel.

programme.title: Mensch, St. Pauli! - Geschichten rund um die Reeperbahn
programme.desc: Das Hotel East mitten in St. Pauli öffnet seinen Nachtclub nur für ausgewählte Gäste. An der traditionellen Bratwurstbude auf der Reeperbahn wird schon seit Jahrzehnten jeder hungrige Gast bedient. Das weiß der Chefredakteur der St-Pauli Nachrichten zu berichten, der um das Überleben seiner Sexpostille kämpft. Licht- und Schattenseiten liegen dicht beieinander auf Hamburgs sündiger Meile.

programme.title: Mensch, St. Pauli! - Geschichten rund um die Reeperbahn
programme.desc: Hamburgs schrillster Stadtteil vereint die unterschiedlichsten Schicksale: Carmen, 23 Jahre, alleinerziehende Mutter, träumt von einer Karriere als Stripperin. Stefan, gelernter Bademeister aus Duisburg, baut sich hier gerade eine Zweitkarriere als reisender Dessousverkäufer für die Mädchen in der Herbertstrasse auf. Und am Millerntor soll eine Kochschule entstehen.

programme.title: Deutschland Outdoor
programme.desc: Wing Foil Surfen ist der neue Hype im Wassersport. Auf Norderney wollen Felix und Max diesen Trend im Selbstversuch ausprobieren. Die Österreicherin Evi und der Schotte John wollen heute eine Nacht in luftiger Höhe verbringen. Christian und seine Freundin Jana wollen heute mit Hilfe des Mikroabenteuer-Experten Christo Foerster von der Nordsee bis zur Ostsee laufen.

programme.title: Deutschland Outdoor
programme.desc: In "Bayrisch Kanada" wollen die Naturjunkies John und Evi heute mit einem Stand Up Paddle aufs Wildwasser. Die Berliner Köche Christian und Felix machen eine Fahrradtour auf dem Wasser. Und eine idyllische Ballonfahrt endet heute für Felix und Max im freien Fall. GoKart-Fahren kann jeder - Felix und Max wollen heute eine fahrende Bierkiste bauen.

programme.title: Deutschland Outdoor
programme.desc: Die Stuttgarter Felix und Max starten ihr Mikroabenteuer diesmal direkt vor der Haustür. Mit einem Longboard wollen sie mitten auf der Schwäbischen Alb 35 Kilometer zurücklegen. Der Berliner Christian will heute mit seinem Sohn und Freundin Jana ein Floss bauen und das soll die drei am Ende auch noch trocken übers Wasser bringen. Eine idyllische Ballonfahrt endet heute für John im freien Fall.

programme.title: Deutschland Outdoor
programme.desc: Im Erzgebirge haben sich der Mountainbiker Christian und sein bester Freund Til vorgenommen, an zwei Tagen den Bikeman Trail zu bezwingen. Im Allgäu steht John am Abgrund - er testet beim Klippenspringen seinen Mut. Und beim Apnoetauchen im Blindsee erleben Felix und Max einen Tiefenrausch. 15 Meter wollen sie mit nur einem Atemzug bezwingen.

programme.desc: Das "Beast of the East" ist Deutschlands größter Abrissbagger.

programme.title: Männer & Maschinen

programme.desc: Ohne effektive Lagersysteme wäre der schnelle Versand von Gütern nicht möglich.

programme.title: Männer & Maschinen

programme.title: Welt der Zukunft
programme.desc: Die Kraft der Gezeiten ist die letzte große ungenutzte Energiequelle der Erde. Ebbe und Flut sind zuverlässiger als Wind- oder Sonnenenergie. Von Unterwasser-Drachen bis hin zu schwimmenden Plattformen arbeiten Ingenieurteams mit Hochdruck an Technologien, um im großen Stil Energie aus diesen gewaltigen Wasserströmen zu gewinnen.

programme.title: Welt der Zukunft
programme.desc: Die Sonne ist die größte Energiequelle, die der Menschheit zur Verfügung steht. Schon jetzt sind Solaranlagen vielerorts im Einsatz. Aber sie sind immer noch ineffizient und funktionieren nur, wenn die Sonne gerade scheint. Innovatoren suchen nach neuen Wegen, um mehr Sonnenenergie einzufangen und sie auch in der Nacht überall verfügbar zu machen.

programme.title: Welt der Zukunft
programme.desc: Strombetriebene Fahrzeuge sind immer verbreiteter und gelten als großer Hoffnungsträger, wenn es um einen klimafreundlicheren Personen- und Güterverkehr geht. Doch damit sie zur neuen Normalität werden können, gilt es noch so manche Hürden zu überwinden - sowohl in technischer Hinsicht als auch in unseren Köpfen.

programme.title: Welt der Zukunft
programme.desc: Das Metaversum gilt als Nachfolger des Internets. Hier sollen Realität und virtuelle Welt noch enger miteinander verschmelzen. Doch es gibt ganz verschiedene Vorstellungen davon, wie das konkret aussehen soll - sicher ist nur, dass es unser Leben und die Art, auf die wir miteinander kommunizieren, maßgeblich verändern wird.

programme.title: Geniale Zufälle
programme.desc: Ein dreckiges Labor und ein Urlaub führen zur Entdeckung unserer ersten wirksamen Waffe gegen Bakterien: Penicillin. Die Entschlossenheit eines Wissenschaftlers, die "falsche" Lösung zu testen, beschert uns einen besonders starken Kunststoff. Und aus einem nicht funktionierenden Laser wird die LED-Leuchte.

programme.title: Geniale Zufälle
programme.desc: Als der Schweizer Chemiker Albert Hofmann an einem Kreislaufmedikament forscht, entdeckt er zufällig LSD. Ein deutscher Chemiker hingegen will eigentlich einen Farbstoff herstellen, doch es entsteht hochexplosives TNT. Außerdem spielt ein mit Urin gefüllter Kühlschrank eine Rolle bei der Verbesserung der psychiatrischen Versorgung.

programme.title: Geniale Zufälle
programme.desc: Ein gescheitertes Blutdruckmedikament und unerwartet starker Haarwuchs bei einer Frau führen zu einem Mittel gegen Glatzen. Ein Versuch, das Kräuseln des Papiers in einem Zeitungsdrucker zu verhindern, beschert uns die Klimaanlage. Und auch Wilhelm Röntgen wurde bei seiner größten Erfindung vom Zufall unterstützt.

programme.title: Geniale Zufälle
programme.desc: Ein junger Medizinstudent glaubt, dass es einen Zusammenhang zwischen der Kopfform und der Intelligenz seiner Kommilitonen gibt und prägt damit die Neurowissenschaft. Als ein Chemiker im Zweiten Weltkrieg nach transparentem Kunststoff für Zielfernrohre forscht, entdeckt er nebenbei den Sekundenkleber. Und auch das Bier verdanken wir einer Reihe von Zufällen.

programme.title: Princess of the Trap House
programme.desc: When a local drug dealer is arrested and put in jail, he asks his daughter Diamond to run his operation. Diamond takes control of the empire, however it doesn’t sit well with members of the crew. Diamond gets word, from her trusted sources, that two members of the crew are plotting to overthrow her Father’s drug empire. Diamond must get rid of the two disloyal members of the crew before they take control of the operation.

programme.title: The Walk of Rufus
programme.desc: Eldest son, Rufus, takes over the family empire of running the streets of Chicago, but change comes at a cost.

programme.title: Lot Lizards 2: Revenge Route
programme.desc: Destitute and desperate, China is forced to the edge, taking up work as a truck stop sex worker just to survive. Into this grim reality storms Ze, who has come to town seeking vengeance on Angie's sister—the woman who murdered his brother, Tez. But Ze's plans are bigger than just revenge: he aims to rally and recruit every woman working the highway.

programme.title: Gimme the Loot
programme.desc: Big Poppa and Ms. Wallace own and operate their own gentleman’s club, “Gimme the Loot” that’s funded by their criminal earnings. Their revenue is partly earned by their exotic dancers they recruit, who double as their crew to execute heists and bank robberies. But when the new crew finds themselves entangled in a high-stakes world of loyalty, secrets, and danger, their loyalties will be tested, and the crew have to decide if “The Loot” is really worth it.

programme.title: Kiss Me Once
programme.desc: Gabrielle, a delusional romantic, fixates on anyone who shows her the slightest interest. Her obsession turns dangerous when her feelings aren't reciprocated.

programme.title: Nowhere to be Found
programme.desc: Two sisters go on a senior trip to Mexico, led by Ava’s boyfriend Trent. Meanwhile, journalist Jessica Vandross is going to the same Mexican town in search of her sister’s killer after escaping a sex trafficking ring. These stories collide, in a thrilling fight for their lives.

programme.title: Intrigue
programme.desc: Jessica and Darren's marriage has hit a rocky stage in their lives. When a mysterious man named Michael enters her life, Jessica is intrigued explores options that could have deadly consequences.

programme.title: The Comeback
programme.desc: Jeff and Tisa Murray have decided to move their family back to their hometown of Atlanta when Tisa is offered her dream job. The dream becomes a hilarious reality when family issues, Mom's new boyfriend, and ex-lovers are waiting on them upon their return.

programme.title: The Private Secretary
programme.desc: Pamela and Sterling are the married owners of a thriving tech empire, where they have all the power and money in the world. As the demands of their business have grown, they bring on Vanessa, a high efficient and enigmatic private secretary. What initially seems as a godsend, Vanessa soon begins to dive further into their lives, and has an agenda that could bring their empire to ruin.

programme.title: Threaded Lies
programme.desc: When rising fashion designer Dante prepares to launch his brand, haunting messages and resurfaced betrayals from his former partner threaten to unravel everything. As paranoia sets in, Dante must confront the lies he’s built his success on before they destroy him.

programme.title: Double Standards 2
programme.desc: When Pastor Noble Jonez’s carefully constructed image begins to unravel, his wife Trezjiir is forced to confront not only the trauma of her past but the deceit poisoning her present. As buried secrets resurface—ranging from infidelity, hidden paternity, abuse of power, and criminal ties—every lie brings them closer to destruction.

programme.title: Bloodline Secrets
programme.desc: Thirty-three-year-old Keisha is engaged to be married to the man of her dreams, Joseph. Joseph believes he’s ready for marriage with the love of his life but his best friend, John, has his doubts about Keisha’s faithfulness. When family secrets come out of the shadows, it puts their marriage and lives in jeopardy.

programme.title: Game of Cards
programme.desc: When data analyst Nicole Tucker’s car is broken into and a mysterious military-issued card tied to her family legacy is stolen, she’s thrust into a dangerous game of betrayal. Her search for the truth uncovers a chilling connection between the theft and her boyfriend Michael, forcing Nicole to confront dark secrets, deadly allies, and a past that refuses to stay buried.

programme.title: Deceptive Touch
programme.desc: Cam believes she’s finally found “The One” in her charismatic boyfriend Ant. Everything seems perfect until a shocking discovery about Ant’s past threatens to unravel their idyllic life. As Cam digs for answers, passion turns into paranoia, and a twisted game of lies and manipulation threatens to destroy everything she thought she knew.

programme.title: Dreamcars
programme.desc: Seja Jaguar, Rolls Royce ou Bentley, seja Aston Martin ou McLaren, a DreamCars mostra os carros de sonho mais emocionantes, mais bonitos e mais rápidos da Grã-Bretanha. Quer se trate de um luxuoso salão, coupé ou carro super esportivo, estas criações automotivas do Reino Unido combinam tradição com luxo exclusivo, desempenho extraordinário e aquele estilo britânico único.

programme.title: Dreamcars
programme.desc: DreamCars apresenta os carros de sonho mais caros, mais luxuosos e mais rápidos da Alemanha. Seja o Porsche 918 Spyder, o Mercedes Classe S, o M6 da BMW ou o Audi A8, os carros premium da Alemanha são a referência quando se trata de conforto, status, dinâmica e prazer de dirigir.

programme.title: Dreamcars
programme.desc: A Itália é a terra da moda, do design e dos carros mais excitantes do mundo. Em nenhum outro país há tantos fabricantes de carros esportivos tão conhecidos como na Itália. Ferrari, Lamborghini, Maserati e Alfa Romeo são considerados os epítomes dos carros de tirar o fôlego, projetados com formas impressionantes, motores vivazes e uma paixão incomparável. Os DreamCars apresentam os carros esportivos italianos mais exclusivos e rápidos.

programme.title: Dreamcars
programme.desc: Os carros musculares americanos são veículos icônicos, estourando com a potência. Seja o Ford Mustang, o Chevrolet Camaro ou o Corvette, estes muscle cars são cobiçados em todo o mundo por causa de seu design rebelde, cavalos impiedosos e sua velocidade impressionante. Os Dream Cars apresentam os mais espetaculares e mais rápidos carros esportivos e musculares dos EUA.

programme.title: Dreamcars
programme.desc: Belezas como o Corvette, Mustang, Camaro ou Shelby Cobra representam o sonho americano de riqueza, excesso e eterna juventude. Estes carros extravagantes e espetaculares com seus enormes capôs, decoração cromada exuberante e grandes barbatanas de cauda têm sido o epítome de limusines excitantes desde os anos 50. DreamCars apresenta os carros clássicos mais excitantes dos EUA.

programme.title: Bentley Bentayga
programme.desc: Com a Bentley Bentayga, a tradicional marca britânica está entrando no segmento de mercado que mais cresce. Este primeiro SUV de luxo do mundo é um conglomerado de superlativos sobre rodas.

programme.title: Ford GT40 - Project 'Victory in Le Mans'
programme.desc: Com seus carros V8, a Ford mostrou que eles foram capazes de construir vencedores de corrida. O Ford GT40 foi um excelente exemplo para isso, especialmente em Le Mans.

programme.title: BMW Active Hybrid 7
programme.desc: Com a Active Hybrid 7, ao contrário de sua antecessora com o mesmo nome de modelo, BMW agora conta com um híbrido completo, que também pode ser acionado exclusivamente com energia elétrica.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: Estar um passo à frente do tempo sempre foi um pouco mais caro. Mas será o novo BMW i8 apenas um luxuoso e vanguardista transportador de tecnologia ou já pode ser considerado como um carro esportivo sério? Por que você deveria pagar o dobro do preço em comparação com o BMW M4? Por que você não deveria comprar um BMW M5 de boa aparência, que tem o mesmo preço, mas é mais funcional? Os supercarros revelam as respostas.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: O Porsche 911 GTS é o mais recente modelo da icônica linha de carros esportivos 911. Com uma potência de 430 HP, ele fecha a lacuna entre o modelo S e o GT3. Os supercarros têm a chance de dar uma volta no novo Porsche 911 GTS na Califórnia. Além disso: O Roding Roadster é um carro esportivo leve da Baviera em pequena série e utiliza tecnologia da BMW sob seu capô.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: Hoje em dia dificilmente há um fabricante de automóveis que não construa qualquer tipo de SUV. Três dos SUV mais esportivos do mercado são os Porsche Macan Turbo, Mercedes GLA 45 AMG e Audi RSQ3. Cada um deles vem com mais de 300 HP; eles estão bem preparados para qualquer temporada e têm ambições de serem carros esportivos. Supercarros descobre, se eles têm o que é preciso para ser um carro esportivo.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: O Porsche Panamera Turbo S é o sedan mais dinâmico do mundo. Nenhum outro carro encontra o equilíbrio perfeito entre, por um lado, o deslizamento calmo e, por outro, o desempenho extremo. 570 hp, 3,8 segundos de zero a 100 km/h e uma velocidade máxima de 310 km/h são dados de desempenho impressionantes para este grande carro. Além disso: o Jaguar XJR com motor V8 de 550 cv e o Mercedes CLS 500.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: O luxo não significa necessariamente perda de tempo. Híbrido é uma das técnicas que promete menor consumo de combustível com um motor ainda potente. A Lexus é a pioneira na eletrificação de automóveis. Os supercarros conduzem o novo LS 600h, o BMW Active Hybrid 7 e o Porsche Panamera S E-Hybrid.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: A Silvretta Hochalpenstrasse na Áustria é o recreio ideal para os pacotes de potência leves Lotus Elise e Roding Roadster. Estes dois roadsters estão colados à rua e, portanto, muito divertidos de conduzir. E: o elegante mas ainda muito potente Porsche 911 Targa 4S.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: Se as pessoas ouvirem o nome Aston Martin, imaginam aventuras James Bond, estilo britânico, performance e luxo. O modelo Vantage N430 da marca é um carro desportivo que faz os condutores e entusiastas sentirem a herança dos carros de corrida britânicos. Também: uma combinação de elegância e potência, o Bentley Continental GTC Speed com o seu motor W12 Twin Turbo.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: Em 2014, a Mercedes-Benz apresentou o seu primeiro Plug-in Híbrido, o S500. Com um consumo médio declarado de 2,8 litros, o S500 foi o carro de luxo mais eficiente do mercado em termos de consumo de combustível. Também: quando se trata de Bentley, um motor V8 significa basicamente um down-sizing. Demos uma vista de olhos à versão Flying Spur da marca britânica com um motor mais pequeno. E: a 6ª geração Maserati Quattroporte.

programme.title: Volkswagen Touareg V6 TDI
programme.desc: A Volkswagen submeteu o Touareg a uma transformação radical. As esperanças são grandes: tem que vender em grande escala para que a administração possa restaurar a confiança das pessoas na marca Volkswagen.

programme.title: Jeep Wrangler - quarta geração
programme.desc: Em 2018, foi introduzida a quarta geração do Wrangler. Ela continha tecnologia de última geração, mas o visual robusto permaneceu o mesmo. A marca trabalha duro para manter esta silhueta desde o primeiro Jeep de sempre, o Willys MB.

programme.title: Streetwise
programme.desc: O Subaru mostra o novo facelift de seu antigo carro de rali WRX STi. Pequeno, econômico e um carro icônico, o Fiat 500 veio com um novo motor, o chamado Twin-Air.

programme.title: Streetwise
programme.desc: Em 3,7 segundos de 0-100 km/h, emissão zero: o Tesla Roadster Sport. 313 PS, quatro motores e sem som.

programme.title: Streetwise
programme.desc: A marca Infinity não é muito conhecida na Europa. Mas a empresa Renault/Nissan está se intensificando a fim de fazer da marca um sucesso global, começando com o muito luxuoso e belo SUV FX50.

programme.title: Clássicos da Arabella
programme.desc: Carros raros e vistas de tirar o fôlego! O Arabella Classics, é um dos mais exclusivos rallys de carros clássicos da Europa.

programme.title: Bentley Bentayga
programme.desc: Com a Bentley Bentayga, a tradicional marca britânica está entrando no segmento de mercado que mais cresce. Este primeiro SUV de luxo do mundo é um conglomerado de superlativos sobre rodas.

programme.title: Top10 Show
programme.sub-title: Os carros mais rapidos do mundo
programme.desc: Veja o que está quente e o que não está no mundo glamoroso dos carros. No primeiro episódio, daremos uma olhada nos dez carros mais velozes do mundo.

programme.title: Top10 Show
programme.sub-title: Os carros de producao mais caros
programme.desc: Um verdadeiro luxo. O tipo de carro com o qual só se pode sonhar. No programa Top 10 de hoje, vamos mostrar os carros mais caros em produção.

programme.title: Top10 Show
programme.desc: Normalmente, quando se fala de carros, é tudo uma questão de aceleração e velocidade. Hoje, veremos os dez carros mais lentos.

programme.title: Top10 Show
programme.sub-title: Os carros mais inusitados dos tempos modernos
programme.desc: Dia após dia, os departamentos de P&D dos fabricantes de automóveis refletem sobre o que constitui o carro perfeito, na esperança de uma descoberta definitiva. Veja os 10 carros mais incomuns dos tempos modernos.

programme.title: Top10 Show
programme.sub-title: Os carros mais bem-sucedidos na corrida de 24h
programme.desc: A corrida de 24 horas no Nurburgring alemão é uma das corridas de longa distância mais famosas e perigosas do mundo e no episódio de hoje vamos mostrar os carros que mais títulos ganharam.

programme.title: Top10 Show
programme.sub-title: Os Dez carros mais eficientes no consumo de combustivel
programme.desc: Os preços dos combustíveis continuam a subir. As empresas petrolíferas estão justificando isto com altas exigências, aumento dos preços do petróleo e impostos. E os preços continuarão a subir. Razões suficientes para olhar para os carros mais eficientes em termos de combustível.

programme.title: Peugeot 205 Turbo 16
programme.desc: A Peugeot lançou este clássico, todo monstro de tração nas rodas com um único propósito: deveria trazer o Campeonato Mundial de Rally para a França. O Peugeot 205 Turbo 16 sacudiu o mundo do rali nos anos 80.

programme.title: História do carro
programme.sub-title: Historia do carro - Historia da Jaguar
programme.desc: Jaguar, esta é provavelmente a marca de carro mais legal do mundo. Tudo começou como a Swallow Sidecars Company quando seu fundador, Sir William Lyons, construiu sua primeira Jaguar em 1935. Desde então, cada Jaguar tem impressionado com seu poder, dinâmica e elegância. A história do Automóvel traça a história do fabricante britânico desde o primeiro SS 100 até o mais recente F-Type.

programme.title: História do carro
programme.desc: Os carros esportivos e de corrida da Jaguar foram feitos sob medida para a velocidade desde o início. Seja em Le Mans, Daytona ou no Rally de Monte Carlo, a Jaguar não dominava apenas o cenário das corridas internacionais. A História das Cartas de Automobilismo da Jaguar desde a primeira vitória do SS 100 até a Fórmula 1 da Jaguar.

programme.title: História do carro
programme.sub-title: Historia do carro - Historia da Volkswagen, Parte 1
programme.desc: É a segunda maior empresa automobilística do mundo, a Volkswagen AG. Tudo começou em 1936 com um único carro, o VW Beetle. O Carocha foi responsável pela realização do sonho de um carro para as pessoas. O Carocha e o Transportador tornaram a VW famosa. A história do automóvel mostra na primeira parte do sucesso de milhões de vendas e os novos modelos no início dos anos 70.

programme.title: História do carro
programme.sub-title: Historia do carro - Historia da Volkswagen, Parte 2
programme.desc: É a segunda maior empresa automobilística do mundo, a Volkswagen AG. Mas, no início dos anos setenta, a VW está em crise. A VW não tem sucessor para o Carocha. Mas com o sucesso do Golf VW se torna um jogador global. Hoje em dia, 12 marcas pertencem à Volkswagen. A história do automóvel mostra o progresso da Volkswagen - do Golfe para um jogador global.

programme.title: História do carro
programme.desc: Seja o foguete, o Ascona ou o Calibra, há mais de 100 anos o motor Opel tem sido um motor de corrida: o primeiro herói, Carl Jörns, vence quase 300 corridas com a Opel até 1920. A Opel se torna uma marca cult. A História do Automóvel mostra toda a história das corridas da Opel, com imagens emocionantes dos primeiros dias das corridas, dos anos dourados do rali e do DTM.

programme.title: Histórico 'Fórmula V
programme.desc: No final da década de 1950, apareceram na América carros de corrida de Fórmula Vee. No final dos anos 70, a série foi descontinuada. Mas hoje os pequenos runabouts estão novamente em corrida na "Fórmula Vau Europa Histórica".

programme.title: Motorheads
programme.desc: Em 1964, Ferruccio Lamborghini teve como objetivo construir os melhores carros esportivos do mundo, um movimento ousado, estando localizado a poucos quilômetros da Ferrari. Apesar disso, seu primeiro modelo, o 350 GT, deixou a competição para trás.

programme.title: Motorheads
programme.desc: O nome da família Porsche está ligado ao projeto, fabricação e corrida de carros desde o início do século 20. Após a Segunda Guerra Mundial, a Ferry Porsche lançou as bases para os famosos modelos de carros esportivos da marca.

programme.title: Motorheads
programme.desc: Não se pode falar em esportes de rali sem mencionar o nome Walter Röhrl. Desde jovem, Röhrl foi capaz de mostrar seu talento e venceu vários campeonatos europeus, mundiais e outros campeonatos internacionais de rali em sua carreira.

programme.title: Motorheads
programme.desc: Hans-Joachim Stuck é um dos melhores pilotos de corridas da Alemanha. Durante sua carreira, ele não só ganhou a Fórmula II e vários campeonatos internacionais de carros de turismo várias vezes, mas também a corrida de Le Mans 24 horas duas vezes.

programme.title: Ford GT40 - Project 'Victory in Le Mans'
programme.desc: Com seus carros V8, a Ford mostrou que eles foram capazes de construir vencedores de corrida. O Ford GT40 foi um excelente exemplo para isso, especialmente em Le Mans.

programme.sub-title: Mercedes 280 SE encontra a America - Long Island

Há vários carros daquela lenda quase esquecida em um museu de carros particulares na Flórida.

programme.desc: Mientras Betzaida comenta ante su padre y su madre lo dichosa que se siente de tener a R mulo por fin permanentemente en casa, sin la zozobra que de ste, este pendiente de la vida de su ex esposa, R mulo al cuidado de su reci n nacida hija Gabriela sue a con Egl e. Despu s de haber cometido la indiscreci n de informar a Cristina de la acusaci n de robo de la cual Paco acusa a Gladys Egl e intentan enmendar su error al exigirle a su hija absoluto silencio tras saberla involucrada en una especie de romance con Gerson y ser este el hijo de Gladys. A pesar de comprometerse a guardar silencio Cristina rauda y veloz esperando ganar concesiones con Gerson lo informa de los rumores que se tejen en contra de Gladys para despu s ser testigo de la violenta reacci n del muchacho quien al saber de las especulaci n iniciada por Paco la toma en su contra como acto reflejo de ejercer la defensa de su madre. Al sentirse interesada por saber de la vida de Doroteo la Nena si sospechar que Gerson se encuentra enterado de toda la situaci n con respecto a la intenci n de Paco se acerca a Gerson para investigar acerca de la vida de su ex esposo recibiendo del muchacho el rechazo de saberla la esposa de quien esta levantando la calumnia en contra de Gladys. Doroteo dej ndose llevar por la a oranza hacia M Antonia le pide a su amigo ngel una consulta quien a pesar de su malestar por el parto de Betzaida accede a la lectura de CDS, encontr ndose en su disfuncional videncia con el caso de supuesto robo que involucra a Paco y a Gladys. Al encontrarse con Paco Gerson le da rienda suelta a su ira al enfrentarse a l a golpes desahogando as su malestar tras haberse enterado de los rumores que este esparce en contra de Gladys al acusarla de ladrona. A su llegada a las residencias, Rosita y Tadeo son testigos de la trifulca entre Paco y Gerson vi ndose obligados a intervenir para solventar la situaci n y lograr que ambos se separen para dar termino con su pelea, Paco al ignorar que Gerson es el hijo de Gladys amenaza al muchacho con su despido inmediato al no poderle dar explicaci n a la agresiva actitud del vigilante del lugar, ante la amenaza de despido de Paco Gerson toma la decisi n de renunciar a su puesto de trabajo. Ante la manifestaci n de despecho de Dileidy por Lu s Fernando, Gladys se ve obligada a recordarle a su hija que Lu s Fernando esta casado y ahora con una nueva familia. En la consulta semanal con Ed n Pascuita desahoga sus angustias ante su psic logo al informar a este de su terrible sue o tras encontrar a Moncho y Matilde si ndole infiel, ante la obsesi n manifiesta en Pascuita Ed n la aconseja recapacitar sobre su matrimonio al creerla merecedora de una mejor vida en pareja. Al ir en busca de respuestas sobre los sentimientos de Moncho por ella, Pascuita se retira de la empresa de ingenier a con m s dudas que aseveraciones por parte de su esposo. Durante su consulta con Ed n Matilde informa a su psic logo del libertador sue o de encontrar a Gonzalo si ndole infiel obteniendo as la excusa perfecta para echarlo de su vida, ante una reflexiva pregunta de Ed n, Matilde logra caer en cuenta de que su matrimonio con Gonzalo se encuentra irremediablemente en ruinas. En la empresa de ingenier a Yenil y Gonzalo se unen para recordar su aventura, siendo interrumpidos por Matilde quien encontr ndose clara sobre su situaci n le pide a su esposo reservar un momento para hablar. Al continuar con su romance clandestino por lo menos ante los ojos de sus seres m s cercanos Egl e y Santiago se ven victimas del temor de llegar a ser descubiertos por Lu s Fernando. Despu s de haber protagonizado el esc ndalo de su pelea con Paco, Gerson se desahoga con Gavito al informarlo de lo acontecido en su lugar de trabajo y ahora sentir el temor de la reacci n de Gladys al saberlo envuelto en una acalorada discusi n con unos de sus patrones. Entre tanto, Paco conversa con M Antonia al informarla sobre su altercado con Gerson y su decisi n de prohibirle al muchacho su regreso al trabajo por medio de la consulta con la junta de condominio de las residencias, tras escuchar la versi n de Paco con relaci n a su altercado con Gerson M Antonia intenta encontrar un motivo l gico para la actitud del muchacho. Ante los ojos de Lu s Fernando Tatiana y Felicita se convierten en competidoras por su inter s al escuchar de este alabanzas hacia Dileidy. Dileidy se debate en una incomoda decisi n tras haberse preparado para hacerle una visita a Lu s Fernando con la excusa de ver a su reci n nacido bebe, ante la advertencia de Aureliano de continuar d ndole largas a su sufrimiento Dileidy recapacita decidiendo mejor irse en compa a de Aureliano. Ante la presi n ejercida por Gladys Gerson informa a su madre de la acusaci n que se teje en su contra situaci n que lo obligo a ejercer su defensa ante Paco. Al ejercer la defensa de Gladys ante las especulaciones de Pascuita acerca de un supuesto robo de comida Alegr a delata a su hermana Felicita quien al dejarse invadir por la ansiedad no muestra progreso satisfactorio de su enfermedad. Gladys es victima de una crisis nerviosa al saber a Paco conspirando nuevamente en su contra y enfrentado a su propio hijo.

programme.title: Mundo de Fieras
programme.desc: Rosario Flores, conocida por todos como "Charito", es una muchacha buena y hermosa que vive sola en el campo con su madre, Mar a Antonieta. programme.title: Instinto Materno

programme.title: Gata Selvagem

programme.title: Gata Selvagem
programme.desc: Luis Mario conta a Gabriel que precisa se afastar para sempre de Rosaura, para não continuar a machucá-la, pois sabe que não a ama e nunca vai amá-la.

programme.title: Gata Selvagem
programme.desc: Quando Rosaura chega ao aeroporto, vê Eva beijando Luis Mario para se despedir e desmaia no caminho, enquanto Bruno corre desesperado tentando encontrá-la.

programme.title: Gata Selvagem
programme.desc: Eduarda, com ajuda de Panchita, procura o colar de pérolas negras com o qual pretende mandar Rosaura para a cadeia, enquanto Luis Mario escreve uma carta pedindo perdão a Rosaura.

programme.title: Gata Selvagem
programme.desc: Luis Mario se recusa até mesmo a considerar a possibilidade de Rosaura estar esperando um filho seu, como sugere Gabriel, porque isso o obrigaria a voltar para ela.

programme.title: Gata Selvagem
programme.desc: Eduarda pede ao comissário que a deixe ver Rosaura e, quando está frente a frente com ela, a obriga a se ajoelhar, dizendo que só assim retirará a denúncia.

programme.title: Gata Selvagem
programme.desc: Eduarda e Eva esperam Anselmo sair e o atropelam com o carro, depois fogem rindo. Na cadeia, Rosaura acorda assustada de um pesadelo, gritando e chamando o pai.

programme.title: Gata Selvagem

programme.title: O Dia Da Invasão
programme.desc: Na madrugada de 9 de abril de 1940, o exército dinamarquês é alertado: os alemães cruzaram a fronteira; a Dinamarca está em guerra contra o exército mais poderoso da Europa. No sul da Jutlândia, companhias dinamarquesas de bicicletas e motocicletas recebem a ordem de, contra todas as probabilidades, conter as forças até que os reforços possam ser mobilizados. Nessas horas fatais, acompanhamos o segundo-tenente Sand (Pilou Asbæk) e sua companhia ciclista: eles serão os primeiros soldados dinamarqueses a enfrentar o inimigo em combate naquele 9 de abril de 1940.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When Robotnik opens up a resort to make the resident Mobians his slaves, Sonic enlists the help of some robots from an area of Mobius called Scrap Valley.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog

programme.desc: Robotnik reprograms a machine created by Von Schlemmer capable of turning dreams into reality, unleashing a Nightmare Monster upon Mobius.

Could their journey to deliver the wolf safely to wildlife officials be just the thing to guide them to healing?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: A spectacular event on the beach of Gdansk, Poland. A competition in the sand and in the water. Complete with a boat pull. With an impressive line up again, we welcome you to watch us LIVE in the SCL Poland.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Twelve strongman, including defending Worldchampion Matjaz Belsak from Slovenia , will compete on “Air spa” for the title of best in homeland country of Tesla, Pupin, Novak Djokovic. Matjaz Belsak is the SCL leader in this competition, chasing his third victory this season.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The World championship in lightweights of the Strongman Champions League bring to us 50 strongmen from all over the world. All athletes are under 105 kilograms and for them this is the step up to the ultimate heavyweights.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: In this second stage of the World championship of lightweights we will find out who out of the 12 athletes will win the title in the under 105 kilogram category.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The first part of SCL Romania 2018 will be hosted in Brasov. This episode features a new event for Strongman Champion League: “ The Chopper Pull”!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: After three classical Strongman events – Dead lift, Loading and Front hold – and one historical, Chopper Pull for the first time in history of Strongman, now we go to find out who will take title in Romania. This is the second stage in Romania and it remains to be seen who will win the title; Aivars, Travis or Krzyzstof?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The next destination of Strongman Champions League is in a piece of paradise on earth – Curacao. We bring to you some special Strongman events like the Rock Lift, Tug of War and Weight for Height in this episode.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: This is the last competition before the grand finals. After the first three events Zageris is in top place, but can O’Hagan, Baggott, Petursson and Ortmayer step into the final? Last chance some of them will find through events like Forward Hold, Truck Pull, Dead Lift and loading very big objects.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: SCL 2018 Season 5, Episode 14, Road to Mexico
programme.desc: We bring you 50 minutes of Strongman inside. Fears, inspiration, courage, the best and worst from our finalists and their expectation of the finals. We also go to Poland and Germany to represent one day in the training of Krzysztof Radzikowski and Dennis Kohlruss. See all the finalists for Mexico in their comfort zone here, with their backgrounds /motivations /family and friends.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: SCL 2018 Season 5, Episode 15, Mexico - World Finals (Part 1)
programme.desc: The first part of the Strongman Champions League 2018 finals in Mexico. The last twelve athletes all pushing their boundaries and testing their limits to take the World title.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: SCL 2018 Season 5, Episode 16, Mexico - World Finals (Part 2)
programme.desc: After 11 months and 14 competitions all over the world, it all comes down to the final in this episode. The strongmen must show their best skills and every mistake is expensive, so their concentration must be at the highest possible level. Will Krzysztof manage to take off back or will Dainis maintain his lead?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: SCL 2019 Season 6, Episode 1, World Strongest Viking
programme.desc: This year 14 athletes from all over the world came to Fefor to compete in 6 cruel events. We'll see typical Viking disciplines on very heavy conditions in land of snow and ice, World records and athletes like the title defender Krzysztof Radzikowski, strongest guys from Holland and Germany and many more

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The next stop in strongest league of the world is muscle capital, largest number of strong shoulders per capita in the World and of course, the most powerful host in Strongman champions league on the planet. It’s a FIBO - the biggest expo on planet Earth and the second stage of 2019 Strongman champions league, in Cologne, Germany.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: On a spectacular beach in Alanya, the MLO Strongman Champions League Turkey was viewed by thousands of spectators over a two day battle. With 12 athletes at the start over 6 cruel events, like Marble Stone Lift, Truckpull and Deadlift cars. And with the comeback of Travis Ortmayer / USA, former stone king and world ranked competitor. Winner of several SCL stages in the past.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Four times Strongest Man of Holland, Alex Moonen and the “Flying Dutchman” Kelvin de Ruiter competing here in Holland against 12 other strongest men in the world. There were 6 events in total, and 3 in this episode: The first event, a truckpull of 17.000 kg over 25 meters in max 75 seconds, was a real hard pull Also for the World Champion Truckpull, Holland’s runner-up Kelvin de Ruiter, but watch his amazing technique here.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Strongest Man of Holland, Alex Moonen and the “Flying Dutchman” Kelvin de Ruiter, competing in Holland against 12 other strongest men in the world. There were 6 events in total, 3 in this second episode; a Viking-press of 150 kg with the current world record holder Luke Herrick. The fifth event, a front hold of 25 kg is loved or hated by the athletes and lastly, the Stones of Strength.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: An unbelievable TANK PULL of 50.000 kg was at the stage of SCL RUSSIA. Never seen this before! Not only a tank pull was done here but also the Viking Press/ Deadlift Max and Log lift reps were spectacular events to see here in Russia. With Mikhail Koklyaev also as event presenter, the former top 3 world strongest man from Russia was there

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: In this year’s edition on The Balkan Peninsula, we have competing the new talent from Estonia Marko Remlik together with Sebastian Kurek from Poland and yellow leader Kelvin de Ruiter

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Mateusz Kieliszkowski from Poland and Aivars Smaukstelis from Latvia are the strongman future of these days. Mateusz is the best man in the World at the moment to defeat. Only 25 years and such a fantastic strongman. They come here only for a win. But there are 12 more Strong athletes in this episode who want the title of Finland as well.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Mateusz Is leading after day 1 (previous episode) with close behind him Aivars Smaukstelis and Zake Muluzi from the UK. All very exciting! 5 events in this episode: Log Lift, Fram Walk, Deadlift, Sack Throw (Weight for Height), Loading medley.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: In this stage we have a new strong debutant: Oleg Sylka from the Ukraine. He is the new talent, who will stand up against the old champions like ZSydrunas Savickas and Brian Shaw and the Stoltman Brother from the UK. This new talent Oleg is a great character and we will see him flame in the episode in Portugal.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: In Callio is the deepest mine of Europe/ 1500 meter deep, whereas the MLO Strongman Champions League also did 1 event. The Forward Hold, on a 1500 dept/ also a kind of new record/ as it was never done before. Spectacular and new in Strongman sport.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Kelvin de Ruiter is here to defend his SCL World Truck Pull Championships title. But this year, another strong field wants his title. Over 3 different pulls with 3 different trucks, and 14 athletes at the start, it will be difficult for everybody.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: SCL edition Curacao 2019 was a great event, twelve power boys from all over made a great show at the white beaches, and 35 degrees Celsius heat in the Carrabean Islands. programme.title: O Som da Música
programme.desc: Em “O Som da Música”, Jacarelvis e seus amigos apresentam as características e sons de diversos instrumentos musicais pertencentes a diferentes culturas. Cada episódio é dedicado a algum instrumento específico, onde são apresentados brevemente a história, os atributos e funcionamento de instrumentos como o violão, o xilofone, a gaita, piano, flauta, entre outros. E a festa sonora fica por conta de Jacarelvis e seus amigos, que apresentam as suas habilidades musicais com cada um dos instrumentos.

programme.title: O Mago das Formas
programme.desc: Viaje para um mundo mágico onde o simpático Mago das Formas revela os segredos dos desenhos! Em cada episódio, três novos desenhos são criados usando formas geométricas básicas e elementos surpresa. Desafios de atenção e curiosidades tornam essa série divertida e educativa, ensinando o conceito de desenho por meio de formas geométricas. Divirta-se e aprenda com o Mago das Formas!

programme.title: Jacarevis e Amigos
programme.desc: Prepare-se para cantar, dançar e aprender! No Volume 01, Jacarelvis e sua turma misturam rock, reggae, blues e até bossa-nova para transformar o dia a dia das crianças em música e diversão. Entre abelhinhas parceiras, escovação de dentes, frutas, bichinhos de estimação e até lições sobre arrumar a bagunça, cada clipe traz humor, energia e muito aprendizado em ritmo animado!

programme.title: Talking Tom and Friends Minis

Veja as aventuras hilariantes deles e prepare-se para sorrir sem parar!

programme.title: BarryTiger
programme.desc: BarryTiger é uma série animada em 3D vibrante e envolvente, criada para crianças de 1 a 8 anos, que dá vida às aventuras do dia a dia por meio de músicas cativantes e encantadoras. Com uma variedade de personagens coloridos e temas ricos e diversos, a série retrata os momentos alegres da vida da família BarryTiger. A produção musical de alta qualidade — com melodias, arranjos e interpretações de excelência — adiciona ainda mais diversão às cenas animadas e sempre surpreendentes. Prepare-se para cantar, dançar e explorar com Barry e seus amigos em cada episódio emocionante!

programme.title: Domi Kids

A equipe profissional de produção musical garante melodias de alta qualidade, arranjos cativantes e interpretações vocais impecáveis, proporcionando um verdadeiro banquete audiovisual para as crianças. O conteúdo é positivo, divertido e pensado para ajudar as crianças a aprenderem e explorarem o mundo de forma apropriada para sua idade. programme.desc: Leila, a lonely young soul spends the night partying with her friends Nancy, David and Nash in a warehouse. A 200 year old Dracula escapes from a crate and reveals himself to Leila and tells her that she is his lost love. For him to live again and be with her, she must bring him the blood of her friends to drink and make love to him. Hypnotized by his sexual powers, Leila does as she is told. Leila and a handsome young Dracula get away and live happily ever after.

programme.desc: As the SoCal Bluefin Tuna fishing season begins to take shape, Ali and Rush head out to fish the waters of San Diego and see what new surprises may be in store for them this year. It's parking lot fishing at its best, but with a change in technique and break from the crowd Ali puts Rush on the bite!

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: When it comes to fishing and the marine industry, we are often more united by the Bluefin tuna than we think. For wildlife biologist Forrest Galante and master sushi chef Hiroyuki Terada, catching a bluefin tuna on rod and reel will be a first!

programme.desc: In Episode 3, Josh starts off in the Twin Cities where he meets up with Yia Vang, an award-winning Hmong chef and restaurant owner, bringing his family’s traditions and flavors to the American Midwest. As Josh heads up north to Duluth and the boundary waters, he’ll meet plenty of farmers and foragers—harvesting mushrooms, wild rice, and catching a few fish (and waves) along the way. It all wraps up with an epic feast hosted by Yia back in the cities.

programme.title: Dirt

programme.desc: New. York. City. That’s where our host Josh Rosen kicks off his journey in Episode 4—and where he lived for 16 years and started up the surf-centric apparel brand, Saturdays NYC. Back in his old stomping grounds, Josh first meets up with the award-winning chef and Mumbai native, Chintan Pandya, currently blowing up the New York food scene with his unapologetic and authentic Indian cuisine (pro tip: try the goat brains). Next, Josh travels through the boroughs, heads upstate, and along the coast to source local ingredients—from sake brewers and pig farmers to catching fresh lobster just 100 miles from Wall Street. As always the adventure will end with a feast, right back in Chintan’s kitchen.

With the whitetail rut in the midwest winding down, the Winchester Life Crew of Chris Keefer, Casey Keefer, Nikki Boxler and Paul Sawyer head south to the Texas Panhandle with Winchesters in hand hoping to wrangle in a few Texas-sized giants.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: The positive impact made by the shooting sports and recreational shooting to people across our country can’t be measured in just one story, so we have three. In Florida, Olympian Dania Vizzi trains at her home shooting facility and talk about how she went from ballerina to one of the best shotgun shooters in the world. In Nebraska, firearms instructor Thea Van Syoc has used the disciplines of competitive pistol shooting and training to help shape her life. Finally we’ll take a look into the National African American Gun Association and learn how one day at the range for Phillip Smith created the fastest growing firearm organization in the United States.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Nikki Boxler’s life in Update New York on her family farm raising cattle and producing maple syrup is a few thousand miles from the hills of New Mexico. We’ll also head to Missouri and Texas to chase whitetails with Chris Keefer and Paul Sawyer.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: We set out to tell the tale of Marion - and his legendary Mack’s Prairie Wings, smack dab in the middle of the world famous Stuttgart, Arkansas - the land of ducks and rice. Get an inside look at a man that many consider to be larger than life, from those that knew him best, like his cousin and fellow hell raiser, Bud McCollum. We’ll even hear a story or two from Milton Stovesand, an 81 year old former waterfowl guide and Mack’s employee who actually guided John Olin a time or two, and ran the timber holes with Marion. It’s timber holes and tall tales. It’s cups of coffee and cupped up wings. It’s partners in business, and partners in potholes and it’s pure Arkansas...just like Marion.
